neighbours.label: ' to' (purpose infinitive) directly after the noun 'assessment(s)'; the output suppresses assess- tokens
fire: The bank requires a credit assessment to approve any loan above that amount.
Each term the pupils sit a reading assessment to show how far they have come.
The surveyor made a quick assessment to see whether the roof was safe.
Doctors use a bedside assessment to decide who needs a scan.
The charity ran a needs assessment to find out which villages lacked water.
New drivers take a practical assessment to prove they can handle the truck.
The coach uses fitness assessments to pick the squad for the tour.
The agency ordered an environmental assessment to measure the harm to the river.
quiet: The bank requires a credit check to approve any loan above that amount.
Each term the pupils sit a reading test to show how far they have come.
The surveyor made a quick sketch to see whether the roof was safe.
Doctors use a bedside chart to decide who needs a scan.
The charity ran a household survey to find out which villages lacked water.
New drivers take a practical exam to prove they can handle the truck.
The coach uses fitness assessments, which the players dislike, in every camp.
The agency ordered an environmental evaluation to measure the harm to the river.

notes: Card: ' to' x14, ' and' x8 after assessment; logit effect suppresses assess-. Probes: 'assessment to' 0.83, 'assessment and' 0.26, 'assess the wound to' 0.46, 'evaluation to' 0.31, 'assessment tools to' 0.09, 'quiz to' 0.07.
